messages:
Dana R.: Quick security advisory — we're rolling out two related changes that require action: 1) immediate rotation of any long-lived internal service tokens older than 45 days, and 2) sunsetting user-managed SSH certs for bastion access in favor of short-lived certs issued by our PKI. Deadline: rotate/replace by EOD next Friday. See internal doc: https://intranet.redwood/sec/credential-hygiene :warning:
Matt I.: Which services count as "internal service tokens"? All infra service accounts? :thinking_face:
Dana R.: Short list to start: api-gateway, model-ingest, realtime-encoder, ci-agent, internal-metrics. If you run services that authenticate with static tokens to other Redwood services, assume you're in scope. We'll expand the list after the first sweep.
Sarah L.: Do we have a script to detect tokens >45d? I can run across clusters.
Dana R.: Yes — use this helper (runs against the secrets inventory):
```
# list tokens older than 45 days
python tools/secret_audit.py --type=service-token --age=45
```
We're also publishing a one-click rotate helper for most common services: https://intranet.redwood/sec/rotate-helper
Matt I.: For services with automated renewers (HashiVault/renewer), will they be exempt?
Dana R.: If the service uses our managed token-service (token-service v2) or Vault with automatic lease renewal and the lease <30 days, mark as compliant. If you rely on manually minted static tokens, plan to migrate. We'll whitelist established renewers temporarily but they must be fully automated by the deadline.
Ben P.: Any impact on customer API keys or prod ingestion pipelines?
Dana R.: Customer-facing API keys and external customer credentials are NOT part of this change. This is internal service-to-service authentication. Prod pipelines should be fine as long as they use short-lived credentials or the managed token-service. If you have questions about a specific pipeline, ping me.
Jules K.: From a compliance perspective, we need audit logs of rotations. Will the rotate-helper emit a verifiable audit event? :page_facing_up:
Dana R.: Yes — rotate-helper posts a signed event to our audit-log endpoint and you'll get a rotation event ID. Record that ID in your deployment notes.
infra-bot: Scheduled job started: secret-audit-scan (scope: eng, infra) — 45d+ tokens scan in progress.
infra-bot: secret-audit-scan finished: 27 matches found. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/secret-audit/17765
Sarah L.: I pulled the 27 matches list — most are ci-agent and a couple of legacy k8s Jobs. I'll open PRs to swap to the rotate-helper for ci-agent.
Dana R.: Thanks Sarah. Action items for teams: 
- Run secret_audit.py and rotate any matching tokens (use rotate-helper when possible).
- Replace user-managed SSH certs on bastions with short-lived PKI certs. Use: `ssh -J bastion` with certs issued via https://intranet.redwood/pki.
- Post rotation event IDs in your change logs.
Please ack in this thread when your team has completed rotations. We'll follow up with a compliance sweep after the deadline.
Emily T.: Ack — SRE will rotate for model-ingest and internal-metrics. ETA Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:
Marc G.: I'll take ci-agent and coordinate with infra to adjust renovator. ETA Thu.
Ben P.: Product infra team will review pipelines this afternoon.
Dana R.: If you hit a blocker (deploy rollback, auth errors), flag #eng-oncall and mention @Dana R. We can extend a short grace period for critical rollout blockers but aim to avoid that. Thanks everyone. :lock:
Sarah L.: noted and starting work now.
